title: Senolytics: Zombie Cells, Longevity, and What’s Possible
abstract: That is, targets for senolytics, the still-experimental drugs and supplements that eliminate senescent cells or tamp down their ill effects. Dasatinib targets certain classes of receptors on the surface of some — but not all — senescent cells, triggering “a natural death process,” LeBrasseur explained. “A senescent cell in the kidney is different than the liver, which is different than the brain.”. “There must be an advantage to having the cells survive and then have the immune system kill them,” Robbins said. A team at Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center and Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory showed that engineered immune cells used for treating blood cancers had a senolytic effect in aging mice. All these senolytics “seem to target different classes of senescent cells,” Robbins said. “And there’s a lot of favorable data to show exercise can help optimize immune health and function, creating healthier environments and tissues for immune cells to recognize, target, and eliminate senescent cells.”.
